settings.heading: Product Details
settings.content: Hydrate, protect, and perfect with Hydra Tint Shield - a moisture-rich tinted sunscreen for fresh, dewy coverage. Lightweight and breathable, it evens tone and protects with SPF, making it your go-to for no-makeup days.

settings.heading: How to Use
settings.content: Apply to your face and neck after cleansing. Blend evenly with fingertips or a sponge for a smooth, natural finish. Can be worn alone or under foundation.

settings.heading: Plump. Hydrate. Shine.
settings.copy: Fuller lips, deep hydration, and high-gloss finish - all in one smooth swipe, for a healthy, radiant, all-day glow.

settings.heading: Candelilla Wax
settings.copy: A vegan plant wax that creates a smooth, flexible texture for a lightweight, comfortable makeup finish that moves naturally with skin.

settings.heading: Vitamin E
settings.copy: An antioxidant-rich ingredient that helps condition and soften, supporting a fresh, healthy-looking finish all day with lasting skin comfort.

settings.heading: Botanical Oils
settings.copy: Lightweight botanical oils help makeup glide smoothly, blend effortlessly, and feel comfortable with a soft, nourished finish.

settings.heading: Nourished from Within
settings.copy: Powered by skin-loving ingredients that enhance color, comfort, and a naturally radiant makeup finish.

settings.heading: Soft, fuller-looking lips
settings.copy: Botanical oils and shea butter lock in moisture the moment you swipe - lips feel less dry and rough, look fuller and smoother, with a soft cushiony finish.

settings.heading: Even, seamless color
settings.copy: Buildable pigments glide on evenly and blend without patchiness, delivering smooth, balanced color that enhances your natural lip tone.

settings.heading: All-day comfort
settings.copy: A lightweight, flexible formula moves with your lips without feeling sticky or heavy, keeping them comfortable through every smile and sip.

settings.heading: Healthy-looking shine
settings.copy: Conditioning oils create a fresh, luminous finish without greasy residue, leaving lips looking naturally plump and polished.

settings.heading: 01. Apply
settings.copy: Start at the center of your lips and glide outward for a smooth, even layer.

settings.heading: 02. Build
settings.copy: Apply a second layer for a darker shade to achieve the desired intensity and shine.

settings.heading: 03. Set
settings.copy: Gently blot with a tissue to remove excess product and help the color last longer.

settings.author: Chloe P.
settings.heading: No flakes, no smudge!
settings.copy: I wore this for 12 hours straight and it did not move at all. It holds my curl beautifully and does not smudge under my eyes. The formula is smooth and coats every lash evenly.

settings.author: Emily D.
settings.heading: Full lashes without clumps
settings.copy: This mascara adds so much volume and length without getting clumpy or flaking. My lashes look full and lifted all day, and it still feels super lightweight.

settings.heading: Beautiful Color, Gentle Care
settings.copy: Ava Collins began with a simple question: why should lasting color compromise comfort? We craft each formula with mineral pigments and botanical oils, sharing every ingredient and its origin - because lips deserve the same care as skin.

settings.heading: Ingredients
settings.copy: Mineral pigments and cold-pressed botanical oils, ethically sourced and traceable.

settings.heading: The Bullet
settings.copy: A refillable aluminum case that stays with you - only the bullet gets replaced.

settings.heading: Transparency
settings.copy: Every shade lists its full INCI, pigment source, and batch date. Nothing hidden, ever.

settings.heading: Beauty that Lasts
settings.copy: Better ingredients, refillable design, and full transparency for beauty that lasts.

settings.question: Is it suitable for sensitive skin?
settings.answer: Yes. Our formulas are thoughtfully developed with gentle, skin-friendly ingredients suitable for most skin types, including sensitive skin.

settings.question: How do I build a routine?
settings.answer: Start with the basics: cleanse, moisturize, and apply sunscreen in the morning; cleanse and apply a nourishing treatment at night.

settings.question: Are the ingredients natural?
settings.answer: Our products prioritize naturally derived ingredients, carefully selected for safety and effectiveness, alongside gentle science-backed actives.

settings.question: Can I mix products together?
settings.answer: Yes. Our products are designed to layer well together. Space out stronger actives such as retinol or AHA/BHA to avoid irritation.

settings.question: Are your products cruelty-free?
settings.answer: Yes. None of our products are tested on animals at any stage of development.
